policy.policy: All valid-odds fixtures get the market benchmark. Model comparison uses complete unique lineups with >=10 dated ratings per side; same eligible rows for both. Use only FC23/FC24 snapshots dated before season start. Existing snapshots are stale. No model or threshold revisions after evaluation. Actual historical starters, not forecast lineups.

limitation: 2025-26 held out from this experiment. Earlier training seasons had prior researcher exposure. FC23/FC24 ratings are stale; actual starting lineups and an eligible subset are used. Odds capture time relative to lineup announcement is not verified.
